executor.why_unreached: the refusal text comes from run_suite at S6, which the main pass does not reach (stops at S5, P1B-9); the dry world has no unavailable executor

no_project.why_unreached: needs a world with no qa-factory/config.json; every dry world has one and a seed may not delete a file

readiness.why_unreached: asks only when a required capability is missing; the dry world's config carries every capability and a seed may not change the config

s0_receipt.why_unreached: needs a stage closed with no accepted S0 receipt; the driver writes it in S0 by code, and a code move with no question pending cannot be observed by the walker

story_budget.why_unreached: printed when recorded spend passes a ceiling; the dry story records no cost and a seed may not write a ceiling

uninitialized.why_unreached: needs a story_step call before the controller is initialized; the driver initializes it in its first turn, and a code move with no question pending cannot be observed by the walker

package.why_unreached: needs a pipeline.json stamped with another run mode or differing hook roots; a fresh world has no pipeline and no allowed seed op restamps run_mode

ticket_changed.why_unreached: needs the ticket in the tracker to differ from the story's snapshot; the dry ticket file never changes and the walker may not edit it
